protocol.geometry: Original simulator depth and world maps; known camera calibration retained
protocol.read_text_file: Baseline permissions; static scoring rules and historical memory retained
protocol.prompt_changes: Removed instructions and examples for the two unavailable geometry tools; updated view_env_state method description
protocol.comparison: One run per setting, paired by task and seed; not full-scene equivalence

nogeom.revision_scope: Official base with local active geometry-tool removal
nogeom.scheduler: Started with six GPU workers; resumed remaining 16 episodes on an eight-GPU shared queue after 144 valid results were preserved

initial_state_audit.scope: Step-0 robot state and task_language; task_progress excluded, full object state not checked

memory_audit.scope: Launch corpus and selected files; actual reading order is not constrained to match

geometry_access_audit.scope: Recorded MCP tool names, geometry filenames in read arguments, and geometry references in native command text; indirect paths, external scripts, historical memory and unlogged execution are not covered

feedback_audit.scope: Saved action results and task_progress counts; not a guarantee that all geometry sources are inaccessible
